description.value: Arms Reach Bistro is a well-established regional bistro situated in the scenic Deep Cove waterfront community of North Vancouver, founded in 2004 by brothers-in-law Alistair Knox and Chef Erick Kauko. Over more than fifteen years it has grown from a small family-run restaurant into a North Vancouver institution earning multiple awards, known for craft cocktails, locally sourced ingredients, and weekly specials pairing local beers with featured dishes. Cyclists rolling into Deep Cove will find both indoor and outdoor seating, along with pickup and delivery takeout options.
